maria_finance: Hey team — noticed a spike in GPU spend last night that doesn't map cleanly to any team budgets. Can someone help reconcile?
ajay_eng: Which project id / billing_export table row are you looking at?
maria_finance: billing export -> `gcp_billing.raw_exports.2026_03_22` line items look like: `project_id=redwood-playground, sku=GPU_T4, cost=1,824.50` but playground budget shows only $200/mo.
sam_ml: Oof. Could be runaway experiments. I ran a quick query on active VMs but didn't see tickets.
ajay_eng: Do we have labels enforced for playground? If VMs were spun up without `x-gpu-owner` tag billing export won't attribute to teams.
nina_platform: We recently relaxed the org-policy for service accounts to allow transient clusters. I pinged infra earlier about tagging enforcement — might be related.
billing-bot: Automated alert: Unallocated GPU spend > $1,000 detected for project redwood-playground (rule: untagged_gpu_spend). Triggered 2143458001.
maria_finance: Thanks @billing-bot. Can we get a list of unique `user_email` / `instance_id` from the 03/22 00:00-06:00 window? I'd like to crosswalk to owners before we reassign costs.
ajay_eng: Running a query now. If owners are missing we can try cost-aggregation by `oauth_user` in IAM logs.
sam_ml: Also check our `playground` quota overrides — some teams do ephemeral large jobs under feature flags. I can check experiment-runner logs (cc @nina_platform).
nina_platform: I pulled the list: 6 instances, 4 different service accounts, 2 unknowns. Sharing snippet: 
```
SELECT instance_id, service_account, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `gcp_billing.raw_exports.2026_03_22`
WHERE sku LIKE '%GPU%'
AND TIMESTAMP(timestamp) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2026-03-22 00:00:00') AND TIMESTAMP('2026-03-22 06:00:00')
GROUP BY instance_id, service_account
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
ajay_eng: Results: instance-ml-42 (svc-experiments@) = $900, instance-temp-9 (unknown svc) = $800, rest small. The unknown svc appears to be created by CI job `exp-runner` run by `sam_ml`.
sam_ml: That's me — I kicked off a parameter sweep last night and forgot to flip the sandbox flag. I own the $800. Sorry — will cover from my team's burst budget.
maria_finance: OK great, thanks for owning it @sam_ml. For the remaining $900 on `svc-experiments@` looks like that's assigned to team-experiments. Can we add retro tags so billing export attributes correctly?
nina_platform: We can't retro-write labels in GCP billing export, but we can add an internal ledger entry (chargeback) for March 22. I'll open an ops ticket and attach the query + commit sha.
ajay_eng: Suggest we also add a nightly pulse that validates untagged_gpu_spend < $100 and fails CI for photos/expts creating GPUs without tags. I can add a check to our infra-lint.
maria_finance: Please do. Also: can we schedule an automated daily digest to finance with top 5 unallocated GPU owners? csv to #finance-digest.
billing-bot: Action created: ticket FIN-6423 "Chargeback + retro-tag ledger for 2026-03-22 unallocated GPU spend" assigned to nina_platform.
nina_platform: Created FIN-6423 and added checklist: 1) ledger entry, 2) infra-lint rule, 3) deploy org-policy rollback to require `x-gpu-owner` tag on creation. ETA EOD Wed.
sam_ml: I'll transfer $800 from ML burst budget to cover my part and update docs on experiment flags.
maria_finance: Thanks all. Can someone drop the final cost breakdown csv here once FIN-6423 is updated? I'll close the alert if ledger entry is posted. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: nightly pulse job `untagged_gpu_pulse` will run 03/23 02:00 UTC.
maria_finance: Closing loop — FIN-6423 updated, ledger created, infra-lint merged. Alert cleared. Thanks everyone. :tada:
